title: 第十三章 击杀妖虎第十四章 玄阶武技
content_zh:
“啊……”
尖叫一声的少女翻身向后一跃，一掌拍在地上，再次又是一跃，到达七、八丈之外，躲过了火焰虎的攻击。
但是火焰虎的速度也不慢，刹那之间便将她追上了，挥出一只巨大爪子击向少女头顶。
少女的修为是“炼气境”
，力量和速度按理都不弱于黄阶下品的火焰虎，只不过她的气势完全被火焰虎压制了下去，战斗经验又薄弱无比。
若是给她一个安稳的输出空间，她还能使用雕翎箭对火焰虎造成极大威胁，可在如此近距离的战斗中，手中已没有了武器，根本不可能是火焰虎的对手。
巨虎爪子还没有拍下，少女脸颊便被劲风刮得生冷，让她不由自主发出一声惊叫。
甚至……
很干脆果断的闭紧了眼睛。
就在她以为自己要死了的时候，闭目前的眼角余光，却看到一道人影疾速冲撞过来，竟然用肉身直接撞向火焰虎庞大的身躯。
爆发出上千斤的力量，叶枫狠狠一下撞在火焰虎背部，将火焰虎撞得抛飞了出去。
“轰隆！”
火焰虎的注意力再度被叶枫吸引。
少女这才往后跃开，心有余悸的捡回短弓。
“吼！”
受挫的火焰虎发出愤怒嘶吼，方才叶枫撞中火焰虎的瞬间，顺手将原本射中它躯体的那支雕翎箭狠狠插了进去，使得火焰虎剧痛难耐，受创极重。
它身上红光变得更加明亮，巨大身影化为一道火红残影，瞬间冲到叶枫身前。
在火焰虎扑至的刹那，叶枫便双腿蹬地，借助弹力冲起丈许多高。
“给我滚开！”
手中药锄爆射光芒，叶枫体内发出低亢的类似于虎啸之声，肌肉和骨骼力量全都调动了起来。

千斤虎力瞬间爆发。
可是火焰虎不但速度快，防御也是极强，这一锄头斩中虎身，只是让它倒退了数步。
“哗！”
火红色影子一闪之后再度出现在叶枫身前，尖锐犹如刀戟的虎爪狠狠拍向叶枫胸口。
方才这一击，已经让叶枫手中药锄支离破碎，这时候只能用右手砸出一拳，与火焰虎硬拼了一击。
“嘭！”
一股强大的冲击力从掌心传来，他的右臂立刻失去知觉。
借着反击力道快速后退着，叶枫向自己右手看去，手掌已被火焰虎身上红光烧伤，连衣袖都被烧成灰烬，露出手腕和臂膀，右臂处还有三条深可见骨的血痕。
不过万古长青脉微微震动了一下，爆发出一股温暖气流，原本麻木的手臂很快恢复了知觉，就连那几条被虎爪划伤的血痕也以肉眼可见的速度恢复着……
就在这时，心绪安宁了不少的少女一连射出两箭，皆是射向火焰虎的眼睛。
“嘭！”
“嘭！”
火焰虎反应极快，爪子扬起，直接将将两支利箭打飞出去。
content_en:
"Ah..."
The girl who screamed turned over and jumped back, slapped her palm on the ground, and jumped again, reaching seven or eight feet away, and dodged the flame tiger's attack.
But the Flame Tiger was not slow either. He caught up with her in an instant and struck the girl above the head with a huge claw.
The girl’s cultivation is “Qi Refining Realm”
, the strength and speed are not weaker than the low-level yellow-level Flame Tiger, but her momentum is completely suppressed by the Flame Tiger, and her combat experience is extremely weak.
If she is given a stable output space, she can also use carved feather arrows to pose a great threat to the Flame Tiger. However, in such a close battle, there is no weapon in her hand, and it is impossible to be the opponent of the Flame Tiger.
Before the giant tiger's claws were taken down, the girl's cheeks were blown cold by the strong wind, causing her to scream in surprise.
Even...
He simply and decisively closed his eyes.
Just when she thought she was going to die, out of the corner of her eyes, she saw a figure rushing over quickly and directly hitting the huge body of the flame tiger with its physical body.
With an explosion of over a thousand kilograms of force, Ye Feng hit the Flame Tiger's back hard and threw the Flame Tiger away.
"Boom!"
Flame Tiger's attention was once again attracted by Ye Feng.
The girl jumped back and picked up the short bow with lingering fear.
"Roar!"
The frustrated Flame Tiger roared angrily. The moment Ye Feng hit the Flame Tiger, he inserted the carved feather arrow that originally hit its body, causing the Flame Tiger unbearable pain and severe injuries.
The red light on its body became brighter, and the huge figure turned into a fiery red afterimage and rushed to Ye Feng in an instant.
The moment the flame tiger pounced, Ye Feng kicked off his legs and used the elastic force to fly up to a height of several feet.
"Get out of my way!"
The medicine hoe in his hand burst with light, and Ye Feng's body made a low-pitched sound similar to the roar of a tiger, and all the strength of his muscles and bones were mobilized.
A thousand catties of tiger power exploded instantly.
However, the Flame Tiger was not only fast, but also had extremely strong defense. The hoe hit the tiger's body and only caused it to take a few steps back.
"Wow!"
The fiery red shadow appeared in front of Ye Feng again after a flash, and the tiger claws as sharp as a halberd slapped Ye Feng's chest hard.
The blow just now had shattered the medicine hoe in Ye Feng's hand. At this time, he could only punch with his right hand and fight the Flame Tiger head-on.
"Bang!"
A powerful impact came from his palm, and his right arm immediately lost consciousness.
Using the strength of his counterattack to retreat quickly, Ye Feng looked at his right hand. His palm had been burned by the red light from the Flame Tiger, and even his sleeves had been burned to ashes, exposing his wrist and arm. There were three deep blood marks on his right arm that were visible to the bone.
However, the Evergreen Veins vibrated slightly and burst out with a burst of warm air. The numb arms quickly regained consciousness, and even the blood marks scratched by the tiger's claws recovered at a speed visible to the naked eye...
At this moment, the girl, who felt much more at peace, shot two arrows in succession, both of which were aimed at the eyes of the flame tiger.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
The flame tiger reacted very quickly, raised its claws, and directly knocked away the two sharp arrows.
